name: qs-design
description: A single routed product-design skill for iOS, Android, web, WeChat Mini Programs, and Alipay Mini Programs.

interface.shortDescription: 跨平台页面设计、可操作原型与交互验证
interface.longDescription: 从任务与内容形成原创视觉方向，先制作隔离的可操作原型并等待明确确认，再按 iOS、Android、Web、微信小程序和支付宝小程序的真实能力实现，同时验证内容、交互、可访问性、性能与来源。
defaultPrompt: Use QS Design to produce an isolated, platform-appropriate prototype for review before modifying product code.
Use QS Design to turn this product flow into a concise clickable prototype, wait for explicit approval, then implement the approved version.
